product_title: Laptop Stand Ergonomic Adjustable - Sturdy Portable Desk Riser for 17.3" Laptops & Notebooks

x.text:
The 17.3-inch Laptop Stand supports laptops from 10 to 17.3 inches in size and features a height adjustment range of 7 inches. Made of aluminum, it has a weight capacity of 11 pounds and folded dimensions of 10 x 8.7 x 1.8 inches, weighing 1.7 pounds.

Link: https://link.amazon/B0hwa4Nkm
